The report cites [@jeffery2011meta], [@lehmann2011biochar], [@daryanto2016drought], and [@novak2009ph], but there is no evidence these keys exist in references.bib (the file is not shown and no tool results are available). The agent appears to have fabricated or hallucinated plausible-sounding references rather than verifying their presence in references.bib, and constructed post-hoc justifications linking them to wheat/drought without direct evidence of such specific claims in those papers.
